text:
Ava Chen: Quick design pass request on the autoscale control panel — focus on SLO slider defaults, min/max affordance, "burst" wording, and fallback messaging. Can do a microcopy + a11y sweep?
Jun Park: Saw this. Slider default at 95% is causing big min bumps. Recommend soft default 65% and an inline helper: 'Start conservative; adjust after traffic stabilizes.'
Sofi Gomez: Accessibility note: pool selector currently traps focus after close and VoiceOver reads duplicate "Pool" headings on cards. Make it a role=dialog (aria-modal=true) and ensure focus returns to the trigger. Also unique aria-labels on cards please.
Marco Rivera: Multiple users have asked if "burst" is permanent. Two quick fixes: 1) label as "Burst (temporary)" 2) helper text: "Short-term extra GPUs — billed separately; auto-scales down."
Ellie Tran: Fallback toast today is opaque. Proposed toast copy (v1):
```
Fallback active: selected GPU pool at capacity. Requests are routed to Redwood Hosted to preserve availability. Data remains encrypted in transit. To keep traffic on Dedicated pools, reserve capacity or increase min. (View details)
```
Ellie Tran: Also recommend a subtle non-blocking banner in the console when fallback is live that links to a modal explaining perf & privacy tradeoffs.
ci-bot: deploy notice: autoscale-ui/v3 deployed to staging at 2025-01-10T09:15:00Z — please validate keyboard & screen reader flows.
Jun Park: Also want a small cost-delta indicator next to the SLO slider (e.g. estimated $/hour) and a tiny sparkline under min/max when min=0 + burst enabled to show cold-start/tail latency risk.
Ava Chen: Good list. Proposed action owners: Jun -> cost delta + sparkline prototype; Sofi -> keyboard/VO pass + ARIA snippets; Marco -> two microcopy options for burst & slider hint; Ellie -> fallback modal copy and banner designs. Can we aim for staging QA by EOD Wed?
Sofi Gomez: I can start tomorrow AM and will drop specific aria attributes in Figma.
Marco Rivera: I'll post two copy variants by EOD today.
Jun Park: Will mock cost delta and tiny sparkline today; will add methodology hover.
Ava Chen: Thanks all — I'll update the Figma and paste the link here when ready. :raised_hands:
